title: WakeEvent
description: A wake event, normalised from every source (GitHub, schedule, dashboard or another bulb). Carries provenance (`caused_by` and `depth`) so the runner can refuse events past a maximum depth and a bulb can't loop on its own pushes.

source.description: Where the event came from: github, schedule, dashboard, or bulb (emitted by a bulb, e.g. an outcome).

type.description: Dotted event type, e.g. dependabot.pr.opened, security.alert, check.completed, schedule.tick or action.retry.

payload.description: Source-specific event data; never holds secrets.

depth.description: How many events or tasks led to this one; 0 for an external root event. The runner refuses events past its maximum depth.

caused_by.description: The event or task that led to this event; absent for an external root event, required when depth is 1 or more.

kind.description: Whether the cause is an event or a task.

id.description: Id of the causing event or task.
